biggest_catch: Ordinary Sweatcoins are NOT cash: official terms state 'Sweatcoins cannot be redeemed for cash from SweatCo or any of its affiliates' — real money only comes via the separate $SWEAT crypto route (Sweat Wallet → exchange sale), and the token's value is tiny (fractions of a cent).
catches: Official terms (sweatco.in/tnc): 'Sweatcoins cannot be redeemed for cash from SweatCo or any of its affiliates, unless we expressly agree otherwise with you in writing.'
Cash requires the crypto path: earn Sweatcoins → install Sweat Wallet → mint $SWEAT (first 5,000 steps/day) → transfer to a crypto exchange → sell. Each step adds friction and fees.
$SWEAT price is extremely low (~$0.0006/token reported) — realistic earnings are dollars per year, not dollars per day.
In-app rewards are mostly discounts, subscriptions, and merchandise — not money.
Battery/data drain from step tracking; standard health-app privacy tradeoff.

steps: Install the free Sweatcoin app and walk to earn Sweatcoins (first 5,000 steps/day count).
Install the Sweat Wallet app and link your Sweatcoin account.
Mint/convert Sweatcoins into $SWEAT crypto tokens inside Sweat Wallet.
Transfer $SWEAT to a supported crypto exchange.
Sell $SWEAT for fiat currency and withdraw to your bank or wallet.
